html:
Hurricane Irma struck the northern Leeward Islands as a category 5 storm on 6 September 2017. Saint Martin, Barbuda, Anguilla and the Virgin Islands took the worst of it.

On Saint Martin most buildings were damaged and looting broke out. On Barbuda nearly every house was hit, and the whole population was taken to Antigua, leaving the island empty for the first time in centuries.

Two weeks later Hurricane Maria struck Dominica and Puerto Rico. The two storms raised hard questions about rebuilding, insurance and help from Paris, London and The Hague.
sum: Hurricane Irma struck the northern Leeward Islands as a category 5 storm on 6 September 2017. Saint Martin, Barbuda, Anguilla and the Virgin Islands took the worst of it.
